_about: 2-Propanol (1) + n-Hexane (2): isothermal total pressures at 483.15 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of 2-propanol, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.

source.citation: J. Seo, J. Lee, H. Kim, Measurement and correlation of vapor-liquid equilibria for the 2-propanol + n-hexane system near the critical, J. Chem. Eng. Data 48 (2003) 856-859
